question: Which customer has spent the highest total amount on orders?
expected_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which employee has the highest salary and in which department do they work?
expected_sql: SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, d.dept_name, e.salary FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON e.dept_id = d.dept_id ORDER BY e.salary DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What is the average employee salary per department?
expected_sql: SELECT d.dept_name, COUNT(e.emp_id) AS emp_count, ROUND(AVG(e.salary), 2) AS avg_salary FROM departments d JOIN employees e ON d.dept_id = e.dept_id GROUP BY d.dept_id, d.dept_name ORDER BY avg_salary DESC;

question: List all students enrolled in Computer Science courses with an 'A' grade.
expected_sql: SELECT s.name AS student_name, c.title AS course_title, e.grade FROM students s JOIN enrollments e ON s.student_id = e.student_id JOIN courses c ON e.course_id = c.course_id WHERE e.grade LIKE 'A%';

question: List all products along with their category name and price sorted from most expensive to least expensive.
expected_sql: SELECT p.product_name, c.category_name, p.price, p.stock_quantity FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id ORDER BY p.price DESC;
